---
title: "EDA for Two Categorical Variables"
format: html
---

## Libraries

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
```


## Loading in Data

```{r}
movies <- read.csv("../datasets/movies.csv")
```

## Contingency Tables

```{r}
movies <- movies |> 
  mutate(newCent = ifelse(title_year >= 2000, "21st", "20th"))
```

```{r}
table(movies$content_rating, movies$newCent)
```

## Stacked Bar Plots

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(movies, aes(x = newCent, fill = content_rating)) +
  geom_bar() +
  xlab("Century") +
  ylab("Count") +
  labs(fill = "Rating") +
  theme_bw()

p2 <- ggplot(movies, aes(x = newCent, fill = content_rating)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  xlab("Century") +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  labs(fill = "Rating") +
  theme_bw()

grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol=2)
```

## Mosaic Plots

```{r}
mosaicplot(table(movies$content_rating, movies$newCent), color = c("lightgreen", "lightblue"), main = "Mosaic Plot of Content Ratings and Centuries of Movies", las = 2)
```
